d:
Melbourne ki food markets, coffee culture aur khoobsurat coastal views explore karne ka apna hi maza hai! Iss vlog mein hum pahunche Coles ke headquarters, jahan team ke saath Indian Khichdi share ki aur unka response dekhkar bahut achha laga.
Uske baad shuru hui Melbourne mein lunch ki talaash, South Melbourne Market ki food exploration, fresh seafood, lobster roll aur coffee ka maza! Saath hi dekhiye Great Ocean Road, Torquay ke beautiful beaches, fish and chips aur Melbourne ki iconic street art. Ek din, dher saara food aur amazing views — Melbourne ka yeh safar yaadgaar raha!
